info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Customer Management Sales Product Agreements-spec
info.description: This API enables users to access and retrieve comprehensive information regarding sales product agreements in customer management. It provides details such as agreement terms, associated customers, and sales products, empowering financial institutions and customer service teams to enhance their relationship management capabilities. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, customer support representatives, and sales agents who need to analyze and manage product agreements efficiently. By leveraging this API, developers can streamline customer interactions and improve service delivery.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all sales product agreements linked to customer management. Utilize this to view or assess existing agreements for customers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details about the sales product agreement for a customer. It requires a specific structure that meets the desired schema for successful processing. Please ensure to adhere to the defined schema to avoid errors.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the sales product agreement.
